$comment: MON-02 (Phase 53). The Upptime status targets, one per public surface the status page covers. This list is not hand-kept: scripts/verify-upptime.mjs derives the expected set from configuration.toml at check time and compares it by set equality. The events target (the telemetry POST /events route) joins when configuration.toml declares [telemetry] endpoint; until then the row names it as deferred and does not guess a host.
